events.verdict: Russell (BKN) brings his left hand towards the ball and makes contact with it, which legally dislodges it from Knecht's (LAL) grasp.
Claxton (BKN) legally contests Vincent's (LAL) jump shot attempt.
Vincent (LAL) legally contests Russell's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Russell (BKN) moves forwards into Vincent (LAL), initiating illegal body contact as he receives the pass.
Doncic (LAL) legally contests Johnson's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Martin (BKN) legally contests Reaves' (LAL) jump shot attempt.
Russell (BKN) brings the ball into the frontcourt within eight seconds.
Russell (BKN) places his off-arm against Vincent (LAL) and releases away as he steps back.
Vincent (LAL) legally contests Russell's (BKN) jump shot attempt.

Claxton (BKN) briefly has a hand on Vanderbilt's (LAL) back as he moves to establish rebounding position and he immediately slides it off. The contact is marginal and Vanderbilt loses his balance on his own accord.
Goodwin (LAL) legally contests Williams' (BKN) layup attempt.
Doncic's (LAL) arms come forward as he comes together with Johnson (BKN) during the inbound play and the contact is marginal.
Knecht (LAL) and Clowney (BKN) engage and are both able to move freely. When Knecht disengages, he extends his arm into Clowney's shoulder and dislodges him from his position.
Williams (BKN) legally contests Doncic's (LAL) jump shot attempt.
Vincent (LAL) and Martin (BKN) come together at the same spot and the foot contact between the two players is incidental.
Vincent (LAL) grabs Clowney's (BKN) body during the dunk attempt and the contact is more than marginal.
Clowney (BKN) legally contests Reaves' (LAL) driving shot attempt.
Vincent (LAL) reaches in for the ball and initiates contact with Johnson's (BKN) right arm, which affects his SQBR.
Williams (BKN) legally contests Doncic's (LAL) shot attempt.
